product_one_liner.value: Lyric Studio is an AI-native supply-chain decision platform that helps large enterprises model, plan, and optimize decisions from strategy through execution.
product_one_liner.notes: The official description covers supply-chain decisions from strategy through execution and identifies large enterprises with complex supply networks as its target customers: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric.

pricing_page.notes: Lyric has a public AWS Marketplace listing with a Pricing section and a Lyric Studio pricing dimension. This is marketplace pricing, not a conventional self-service pricing page on lyric.tech; the displayed $0.00 should not be interpreted as the full enterprise contract price. Source: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-kbxc4aoesit6k.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Coca-Cola and BODYARMOR are explicitly listed as organizations using Lyric Studio, rather than investors or partners: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric. | named_customers.0: Coca-Cola appears in the official list of Lyric Studio users: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric. | named_customers.1: BODYARMOR appears in the official list of Lyric Studio users: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 323 employees, which falls within the required 201-500 band. This is a profile-based count rather than an audited headcount: https://linkedin.com/company/lyric-tech.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official company information identifies Sunnyvale, California, as the headquarters city: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric. | hq_country: The official company information identifies the headquarters country as the United States: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric.

founded_year.notes: Lyric explicitly gives 2021 as its founding year: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains at least two substantive implementation articles: “The Real Reason Your Planning System Slows Down,” by a staff software engineer and data architect, explains storage, caching, and scenario architecture; “The Technology Behind Modeling at Scale,” by technically experienced founder Ganesh Ramakrishna, explains Lyric's sequence layer and distributed computation. These are technical posts within a broader company blog, not a separate engineering-only publication. Sources: https://lyric.tech/blogs-and-whitepapers/the-real-reason-your-planning-system-slows-down; https://lyric.tech/blogs-and-whitepapers/the-technology-behind-modeling-at-scale; https://linkedin.com/in/adityajaroli; https://linkedin.com/in/pradeepvijayakumar-4.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation does not expose a public product-documentation or help-center collection, and the documentation address presents an email-access gate rather than several publicly readable articles. This is false for public documentation, not a claim that customer documentation does not exist. Sources: https://lyric.tech/; https://docs.lyric.tech/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Applied AI / GTM Engineer opening explicitly involves building and shipping AI-powered products and agents. Despite its GTM context, it is a technical AI-building role, not an excluded AI-sales title. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lyric/07f709d6-f763-4b19-a246-2cb92e144314.

model_provider.notes: Lyric explicitly says it combines TimesFM and Amazon Chronos in its forecasting offering, including optional fine-tuning with customer data. The same article identifies TimesFM as Google's model: https://lyric.tech/blogs-and-whitepapers/generative-ai-meets-time-series-forecasting.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Lyric claims SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, ISO/IEC 27001 certification, and alignment with GDPR. GDPR is included as a publicly claimed compliance framework, not as an independently certified status. Source: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 Type 2 attestation is explicitly claimed at https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric. | compliance_certs.1: ISO/IEC 27001 certification is explicitly claimed at https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric. | compliance_certs.2: The company claims GDPR alignment, not a separate GDPR certification: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Both current company summaries identify the financing stage as Series B. The amount discrepancy does not affect the stage: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric; https://lyric.tech/about-us. | funding_date: The month associated with the currently reported $55.5 million Series B could not be established. The current timeline places it in 2025 without a month: https://lyric.tech/about-us. The precisely dated August 5, 2025 announcement reports $43.5 million, not $55.5 million: https://lyric.tech/blog/built-for-builders-backed-to-scale-43-5m-to-grow-lyric-s-ai-platform. Assigning that month to the updated amount would require an unsupported assumption. | funding_amount_usd: The current company overview and official information page state a $55.5 million Series B, so that is the reported amount used here. There is a material discrepancy: the original August 2025 announcement reported $43.5 million, and no separately dated explanation of the increase was found. Sources: https://lyric.tech/about-us; https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric; https://lyric.tech/blog/built-for-builders-backed-to-scale-43-5m-to-grow-lyric-s-ai-platform.

raised_18mo.notes: Lyric announced its Series B on August 5, 2025, after the May 9, 2025 start of the requested eighteen-month window. The later discrepancy in the reported round amount does not change this positive funding-event answer. Source: https://lyric.tech/blog/built-for-builders-backed-to-scale-43-5m-to-grow-lyric-s-ai-platform.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Lyric has a live Enterprise Account Executive posting, a qualifying sales role: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lyric/bd834e1f-3499-4c5c-9302-74d017807618.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog history through November 2026 shows analyst recognition and thought leadership, rather than a dated major launch in the requested six-month window. The August forecasting article describes a development direction without an explicit release announcement. The newest qualifying integration announcement identified was NVIDIA cuOpt on March 18, 2025, outside the window. Sources: https://lyric.tech/blog; https://lyric.tech/blog/agents-meet-demand-forecasting; https://lyric.tech/blog/lyric-leverages-nvidia-cuopt-to-elevate-supply-chain-ai.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Deb Kennedy's profile dates her start as Vice-President, AI Supply Chain Sales at Lyric to December 2025, within the requested twelve-month window. Her description identifies Lyric's supply-chain decision-intelligence business, avoiding confusion with healthcare companies of the same name. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/debkennedy938.
